name: Grave Profits
description:
About This Game

Grave Profits is a Roguelike Auto-Battler Dungeon Crawler for Single Player and CO-OP play.  It begs for the ONE MORE RUN feeling with 20 minute runs, as you unlock new game changing relics, units, abilities and dungeons.

Build armored walls with Holy units, who sell faith for coin, and spread Fire and Poison with Eldritch Knights and Alchemists, Eat your priests with the Gargantuan Cyclops. Or create some completely unreasonable abomination between battles and hurl it at the enemy.


Each Hero approaches the journey with unique abilities, starting conditions and mechanics that transform how you build, change the rules, or even introduce completely new Alliances (like the Gnolls) to the game.

Heroes gain experience across expeditions, unlock new hero abilities and powerful Relics. These are not simple stat bonuses. RELICS alter recruitment, change card interaction, rewrite rules and some abilities can even eat opponents units, yum. 

Merge 3 cards of the same type to LEVEL UP. Strengthen your recruits further by mutating and grafting abilities, send units on side quests to gain new traits, or sacrifice units for the good of the party.

Your Steam friends victories and failures can reach into your own expeditions, even when you are not playing together.

  • Discover Abandoned Camps after a friend’s expedition was defeated in the same dungeon

  • Rescue imprisoned Units belonging to your friends

  • Face rival crawlers in battle built by your friends

  • Leave your own traces behind for other friends to discover

Random recruits, dangerous encounters, Tarot cards, Allies, Intruders and constantly changing dungeon laws force you to adapt in every run.  Build around what you find to make your way out.

But be careful, the dark is never safe, bring a torch to burn it away.
short_desc: Build the most game breaking party you can in this dungeon crawling roguelike auto-battler. Recruit, level up, arrange devastating card synergies, and descend into cursed dungeons alone or with a friend in online co-op
